subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FESTIVAL' is written as 'UTFGMBWJ'. How will 'MAJESTIC' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : 

 
• **Immediate next letter of the first four letters is written diagonally.**
 
• Immediate next letter of the last four letters is written diagonally.
